integrity: The lower endpoint, rigidity and interval attainability are obtained by an analytic proof using Schwarz and Parseval. Finite coefficient checks are supplementary. Possible unindexed earlier equivalences remain a literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Normalized close-to-convex harmonic mappings of the disk with the strict derivative inequality and zero initial coanalytic derivative; centered subdisks only. The upper area bound is reproduced from existing literature, not claimed new.
title: The exact area spectrum of close-to-convex harmonic maps
